record.paper_title: Recent Progress and Open Problems in Function Field Arithmetic — The Influence of John Tate’s Work
record.context_brief: General case of ℘-adic arithmetic gamma interpolation
record.original_question: For the ℘-adic interpolation of the arithmetic gamma function constructed by Goss, what is the general transcendence or algebraicity theory for its values, beyond the partial results currently known?

evidence.quote: For the ℘-adic interpolation due to Goss of the gamma, Yao and myself only managed partial results [Tha04, Cha. 11], and the general case is still open.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A=\mathbb{F}_q[T]$ be the polynomial ring over the finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$ with $q$ a power of a prime $p$, let $K=\mathbb{F}_q(T)$ be its fraction field, and let $K_\infty=\mathbb{F}_q((1/T))$ be its completion at the infinite place. Fix a monic irreducible polynomial $\wp\in A$, let $K_\wp$ denote the $\wp$-adic completion of $K$, and let $\mathbb{C}_\wp$ denote the completion of an algebraic closure of $K_\wp$.

The Carlitz factorial $D_i\in A$ is defined by $D_0=1$ and $D_i=\prod_{j=0}^{i-1}(T^{q^i}-T^{q^j})$ for $i\ge 1$. The arithmetic factorial of a non-negative integer $n=\sum_{i\ge 0}n_i q^i$ (with $0\le n_i<q$) is
$$\Pi(n)=\prod_{i\ge 0} D_i^{n_i}\in A.$$
Goss constructed, for each finite place $\wp$ of $A$, a $\wp$-adic interpolation
$$\Gamma_\wp:\mathbb{Z}_p\longrightarrow K_\wp$$
of this arithmetic gamma function (the analogue of Morita's $p$-adic gamma function in the function field setting), characterized by suitably interpolating the values $\Pi(n)$ with the $\wp$-factors removed at non-negative integers $n$.

Problem. Determine the complete transcendence theory of the values of $\Gamma_\wp$ at points of $\mathbb{Z}_p$. Specifically:

(i) For every $z\in\mathbb{Z}_p\setminus\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}$, decide whether $\Gamma_\wp(z)$ is transcendental over $K$.

(ii) For each finite tuple $z_1,\dots,z_r\in\mathbb{Z}_p$, describe all algebraic relations over $\overline{K}$ among the values $\Gamma_\wp(z_1),\dots,\Gamma_\wp(z_r)$, and prove that these relations are exhausted by those induced by the functional equations satisfied by $\Gamma_\wp$.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent surveys and papers indicate that while transcendence of Carlitz–Goss gamma values at non-natural rational/p-adic arguments has been established in partial cases (via Wade's method, Drinfeld modules, hypergeometric techniques), the full transcendence/algebraic-independence theory for all values of Goss's ℘-adic interpolation of the arithmetic gamma function is not complete. Work by Anderson, Thakur, Chang, Yu and others has resolved the v=∞ (Carlitz period and arithmetic gamma at ∞) case completely, but the general ℘-adic case remains only partially understood.

status_evidence.title: Transcendence in positive characteristic and special values of hypergeometric functions
status_evidence.snippet: a new proof of the transcendence of special values at non-natural p-adic integers of the Carlitz-Goss gamma function can be obtained
status_evidence.claim: Only partial transcendence results are available for ℘-adic Carlitz–Goss gamma values.

status_evidence.title: Algebraic relations among special gamma values and the Chowla–Selberg phenomenon over function fields
status_evidence.snippet: transcendence theory of arithmetic and geometric gamma values has been fully developed separately, but there seems to have been no further progress on two-variable gamma values
status_evidence.claim: The full algebraic-independence theory of gamma values over function fields, including the ℘-adic interpolation, is not complete.
